# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 47 tank_core lib tests pass, including: snapshot_tds_and_conductivity_use_fresh_carbonate_projection, reference_sa_v_matches_default_tank_geometry, snapshot_uses_one_carbonate_solution_for_ph_and_co2.
- All 3 tank_api tests pass: snapshot_response_keeps_legacy_chemistry_aliases, chemistry_response_explains_estimate_scope, biology_snapshot_keeps_total_and_stage_breakdown.
- All 9 tank_tui lib tests pass, including: parses_enriched_api_snapshot_response, parses_load_response_with_enriched_api_snapshot, overview_labels_tds_and_conductivity_as_estimates, estimated_tds_scope_lines_name_included_and_omitted_species.
- All 7 events integration tests pass, including threshold_event_summaries_use_explicit_chemistry_units.
- All 10 concentration_helpers integration tests pass.
- All 7 conversion tests pass: reference_values, 5 round-trip tests (nitrate/nitrite/ammonium/ammonia/phosphate), zero_stays_zero.
- cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_api -p tank_tui -- -D warnings passes cleanly with no warnings.
- Snapshot fields verified with explicit unit suffixes: tan_mg_n_per_l, nh3_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_n_per_l, nitrate_mg_n_per_l, phosphate_mg_p_per_l, dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_c_per_l, estimated_tds_7_ion_mg_per_l, estimated_conductivity_us_cm (snapshot.rs:33-45).
- Conversion constants centralized in conversions.rs with molar-mass documentation: NO3_PER_N, NO2_PER_N, NH4_PER_N, NH3_PER_N, PO4_PER_P. No magic numbers found in TUI/API rendering code.
- GH/KH constants named and documented in water.rs: CALCIUM_AS_CACO3_FACTOR, MAGNESIUM_AS_CACO3_FACTOR, MG_CACO3_PER_MEQ, MG_CACO3_PER_DEGREE, MOLAR_MASS_CACO3_G_PER_MOL. ESTIMATED_TDS_TO_CONDUCTIVITY_DIVISOR has a 3-line doc comment.
- TDS/conductivity in snapshot.rs from_state() derives bicarbonate from fresh carbonate_eq.hco3_mmol_per_l (lines 104-111), not the stale cache. Uses tds_mg_per_l_with_bicarbonate_total() and conductivity_us_cm_with_bicarbonate_total().
- TDS scope metadata centralized in tank_core (water.rs:25-41): ESTIMATED_TDS_TRACKED_MAJOR_IONS, ESTIMATED_TDS_OMITTED_CONTRIBUTORS, ESTIMATED_TDS_SCOPE_LINES exported via types/mod.rs and consumed by both API and TUI — no duplication.
- API backward compatibility: insert_legacy_chemistry_fields() backfills 8 old field names. snapshot_response_json() confirmed used on /snapshot, /time/step, /load, and /scenarios/load endpoints.
- TUI api_client normalize_snapshot_object (lines 130-145) strips legacy aliases (lines 139-141) and metadata fields (lines 142-144) before deserialization. 5 tests cover legacy, canonical-precedence, enriched snapshot, and load-response paths.
- TUI labels: overview.rs:132 shows 'Est. TDS (7-ion)' and 'Est. cond'; chemistry.rs:57,61 shows 'Est. TDS (7-ion)' and 'Est. conductivity (7-ion)'. Scope lines displayed on both screens.
- Event summaries use explicit bases: 'Free ammonia (NH3-N) reached ... mg NH3-N/L' and 'Nitrite-N reached ... mg N/L' (events.rs:24,33).

## Findings and Gaps

- The previously-failing tank_tui test rejects_invalid_integer_counts now passes — this is an improvement over the state reported in earlier rounds.
- No dedicated end-to-end TUI render test asserts the exact pixel/text output of overview or chemistry screens; only targeted label and scope-line assertions exist. This is a minor gap but acceptable since the TUI is not a stable API surface.
- The overview hardware panel inserts 3 scope lines which may overflow on very small terminals — a known aesthetic tradeoff for scope transparency.
- The unrelated clippy warning in crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:755 (redundant_field_names) persists but is outside the scope of this bead.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
